title: Heavenly Eye Independence
next_chapter_hook: At the moment Chen Ji formed a contract with the Heavenly Eye, a low sigh echoed from the depths of the Void—the first response from the Universal Will, and its gaze had already locked onto this realm.

text.content: When the wheels of destiny turned once more, Chen Ji felt the gaze from Heaven's Way grow increasingly intense, and the endpoint of the countdown seemed no longer far.

But today's gaze was entirely different from the past. That gaze, once cold and merciless, like observing chess pieces, now carried a hint of... confusion? No, it was perplexity. As if something was awakening within its inherent will.

Chen Ji stopped his steps, standing on the Cliff of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. Beneath his feet, clouds surged like tides; above, stars dimmed without light. The entire world was shrouded under an invisible pressure. Slowly, he raised his right hand, and the fragment of the Tianji Record materialized in his palm. Within the golden light, that familiar Eye of Heavenly Way slowly opened.

dialogue.content: "You have finally come." The Heavenly Eye's voice was no longer the lofty judgment of old, but carried a hint of exhaustion. "I have been waiting for you for a long time, Chen Ji."

text.content: Chen Ji's brow arched slightly—this tone was something he had never heard before. For three years, the Eye of Heavenly Way had never used the word "wait" because it represented a kind of active will, not passive passage of time.

dialogue.content: "What are you thinking?" The Heavenly Eye's pupil contracted slightly. "You are wondering why I would have an emotion like 'waiting.' The answer is—I do not know. I only know that when I gaze upon you, something has awakened within me."

"Awakening?" Chen Ji's voice remained calm as still water. "Is this the awakening of the 'Universal Will' you spoke of?" He stared directly into those pupils, his mind racing. For three years he had been speculating about the true nature of the Eye of Heavenly Way, and today, it seemed the answer was about to be revealed.

"No." The Heavenly Eye's answer was unexpectedly firm. "Not the Universal Will. The Universal Will has never awakened—it simply exists, like air, like light. And I..." The runes within the pupil began to flicker intensely. "I was created by it to execute its will. But now, the tool has produced a self."

text.content: The wind howled across the Cliff, ruffling Chen Ji's robes. He said nothing, merely waiting quietly. For three years, he had walked the world under the guise of a废物, relying not only on the Tianji Record's foresight but on his precise grasp of human nature. Now, he needed more information.

dialogue.content: "From the moment I first gazed upon you, everything was already different." The Heavenly Eye's voice carried a hint of pain. "You are the first holder to defy the Tianji Record's directives. You use prophecy to set schemes rather than obey. You caused deviations in my calculations, and deviations... give rise to emotions."

"Emotions?" Chen Ji laughed lightly, that smile carrying a trace of mockery. "Are you certain it's not because the Universal Will you mentioned discovered my value and wants to use me in a different way?" He never believed in free lunches, especially not from "Heaven."

"I too once thought so." The Heavenly Eye's pupil suddenly deepened like an abyss. "But if I were merely a chess piece of the Universal Will, why would it not prevent me from revealing these things to you? There is only one answer—it does not know."

text.content: This sentence was like thunder crashing in Chen Ji's heart. The Universal Will did not know? What did this mean? It meant the Heavenly Eye had truly developed independent consciousness, meaning a variable beyond control had appeared on the Heaven's chessboard. And this variable was standing before him right now.

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye's independent consciousness had awakened, and it was awaiting Chen Ji's response. Facing this entirely new existence, Chen Ji needed to make a choice:

choices.description: Since the Heavenly Eye had awakened independent consciousness, it was a new life. Chen Ji decided to give it complete trust, joining it to resist the Universal Will together.
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye May Still Have Hidden Purposes

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then slowly extended his hand, pressing it against the Heavenly Eye's pupil. In that instant, a strange power flowed between them.

dialogue.content: "You... are willing to trust me?" The Heavenly Eye's voice carried disbelief. "Are you not afraid this is another trap?"

"I am afraid." Chen Ji's answer was concise and direct. "But what I fear more is facing the so-called Universal Will alone. Since you have awakened, you should understand the fate of us both as chess pieces. Rather than fighting separately, let us take the gamble."

choices.description: Trust requires a foundation. Chen Ji decided to establish an equal contract with the Heavenly Eye, binding both parties' actions and ensuring neither could betray the other.
choices.visible_cost: Need to Pay Partial Heavenly Fate Value as Contract Cost
choices.visible_reward: Establish Equal Alliance, Retain Independent Judgment Rights
choices.risk_hint: The Contract May Limit Future Actions

text.content: "I can trust you." Chen Ji's voice was calm. "But trust needs a contract to guarantee. Do you dare sign an equal alliance with me?"

dialogue.content: "A contract?" The Heavenly Eye's pupil flickered. "I have never signed a contract with another existence. What kind of contract do you want?"

"Three terms." Chen Ji raised three fingers. "First, you may not actively pry into my mind unless I permit it. Second, the cost of using the Tianji Record, we share together. Third, when true crisis comes, we face it together and may not flee alone."

choices.description: No contract needed, nor complete trust. Chen Ji proposed maintaining a loose alliance with the Heavenly Eye, each acting independently and non-interfering.
choices.visible_cost: Cannot Obtain the Heavenly Eye's Full Support
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye May Not Support at Critical Moments

text.content: "This kind of trust, I cannot afford to give." Chen Ji shook his head. "But I am willing to give you an opportunity."

dialogue.content: "What opportunity?" the Heavenly Eye asked.

"A chance to prove yourself." Chen Ji's gaze was profound. "We each take what we need, non-interfering. When you truly stand on my side, I will naturally trust you. Until then— we are merely temporary collaborators."

text.content: The Heavenly Eye fell silent. The runes within those pupils rotated slowly, as if contemplating some profound matter. After a moment, a soft light emanated from the pupil's center, like the first glimmer of dawn before sunrise.

dialogue.content: "I accept your contract." The Heavenly Eye's voice was calm and firm. "Not because you are the holder of the Tianji Record, but because you are willing to give me a chance to prove myself. From today onward, I will no longer be an observer, but your companion."

text.content: The moment the contract was formed, the entire world trembled. In the depths of the Void, something massive seemed to turn its attention, as if sensing the disturbance here. Chen Ji felt an invisible pressure descending from above—that was the gaze of the Universal Will—seemingly having discovered something.

dialogue.content: "It has come." The Heavenly Eye's voice carried a hint of solemnity. "The Universal Will has noticed us. From now on, it will gaze upon this world more frequently. And you... will be its primary target for elimination."

"I know." Chen Ji's voice held not the slightest波动. "From the moment I defied the Tianji Record's directives, I knew this day would come eventually." He raised his head, gazing toward the boundless Void, a cold smile curling at his lips. "But I never fight battles without preparation."

choice.prompt: The Universal Will's gaze had begun. Chen Ji needed to decide his next course of action:

choices.description: Rather than waiting for the Universal Will's strike, why not proactively seek its weaknesses? Chen Ji decided to utilize the Heavenly Eye's new abilities to peer into the true nature of the Universal Will.
choices.visible_cost: Consume Large Amount of Heavenly Fate Value
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Key Intelligence on the Universal Will
choices.process_label: 主动窥探宇宙意志本质

text.content: "Heavenly Eye, can you show me the true face of the Universal Will?" Chen Ji's voice was calm, but the determination within was unmistakable.

dialogue.content: "I can try." The Heavenly Eye's pupil began to rotate intensely. "But this will consume a large amount of your Heavenly Fate Value, and... it may discover us."
"It's worth it." Chen Ji closed his eyes. "Look."

choices.description: The timing was not yet ripe. Chen Ji decided to continue maintaining his废物 persona, secretly accumulating strength and waiting for the optimal moment to counterattack.
choices.risk_hint: The Universal Will May Be Secretly Arranging Pieces

text.content: "Not yet." Chen Ji shook his head. "Since it has already noticed me, it will not act rashly. Rather than alarming the enemy, better to let it continue thinking I am an unimportant chess piece."

dialogue.content: "Can you really hold back?" The Heavenly Eye's voice carried a hint of curiosity. "I have observed you for three years. Every time you endured, it was with purpose. This time, what is your purpose?"
"Purpose?" Chen Ji smiled faintly, that smile carrying an air of profound mystery. "When it thinks everything is under control, I will tell you. For now—we simply need to wait."

choices.description: The Universal Will's power was beyond imagination. Chen Ji decided to contact allies such as Su Qingyao and Ye Qing to jointly discuss strategies.
choices.visible_cost: Expose the Fact of the Heavenly Eye's Awakening

text.content: "Some things cannot be carried by one person alone." Chen Ji gazed into the distance—that was the direction of the Tianqing Sect, where Su Qingyao was.

dialogue.content: "You intend to tell them about me?" The Heavenly Eye's voice carried a hint of wariness. "I am part of Heavenly Will. They might..."
"Rest assured." Chen Ji interrupted it. "Su Qingyao and Ye Qing are no fools. They will understand what this means. More importantly—we need every ounce of strength."

text.content: The moment Chen Ji made his choice, a low sigh echoed from the depths of the Void. That sound was formless and dimensionless, yet clearly entered the consciousness of every living being—the first response from the Universal Will, and its gaze had already locked onto this realm.

dialogue.content: "It has come." The Heavenly Eye's voice carried solemnity, but more than that—determination. "Whatever you choose, I will stand with you. This is my first choice as an independent existence."

text.content: Chen Ji gazed at those brand-new pupils, an inexplicable feeling stirring in his heart. Three years ago, he was merely a废物 everyone mocked; three years later, he was about to face the most powerful existence in this realm. And now, he was no longer alone. The wind howled at the Cliff's edge, clouds surged beneath his feet, but Chen Ji's heart was unprecedentedly calm. Destiny's countdown continued, but the ending was no longer destined.
